leadership: Vikram Bajaj — Co-founder & CEO, Foresite Labs; Managing Director, Foresite Capital
Jim Tananbaum — Founder & CEO, Foresite Capital
profile.model: Foresite Labs is the incubation arm of Foresite Capital, a multi-stage healthcare investor. It builds a small number of data- and AI-heavy companies in-house, supplying founding scientists, engineers and operators plus shared AI/data-science capabilities, and sometimes co-incubates with partners such as ARCH Venture Partners. A dedicated $173M Foresite Labs fund (closed 2022) plus Foresite Capital's main funds finance the companies it launches.
profile.summary: Foresite Labs co-incubated Xaira Therapeutics, one of the largest biotech launches ever at more than $1B in committed capital, and its autoimmune bets (Alumis, Candid) have produced an IPO and a roughly $2.2B sale to UCB. It is a compact, AI-first company-creation shop tied to a roughly $3.5B+ crossover/venture firm.

companies.name: Xaira Therapeutics
